units.summary: Adds a method that appends the from-selected-series hint to block meta if absent and keeps hints sorted. It changes the persisted meta.json hints for selected-series blocks.
units.headline: Add SetSelectedSeries to record from-selected-series compaction hint
units.reason: Writes a new value into the persisted block meta Hints list, which other code uses for compaction and WAL cutoff decisions.
focus: Hint is idempotent and sorted, so meta.json stays stable across repeated sets
Older Prometheus versions tolerate the unknown hint string when reading meta.json

units.summary: Adds a read-only predicate reporting whether the from-selected-series hint is present. It is used by the planner, meta merge and inOrderBlocksMaxTime.
units.headline: Add FromSelectedSeries hint predicate
units.reason: Pure side-effect-free lookup; the behavior that depends on it is in the callers reviewed separately.

units.summary: New unit test covering the selected-series hint: initially absent, set, idempotent, and independent of the stale hint. Test-only.
units.headline: Test selected-series hint set/idempotence/independence
units.reason: New test only; cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: The planner now splits blocks into stale, selected and no-hint classes and plans one class at a time, preferring no-hint, then stale, then selected. This keeps partial-view blocks from being merged with other classes, so the hint survives and the WAL-replay cutoff is not advanced.
units.headline: Compaction planner segregates selected-series blocks from other block classes
units.reason: Changes which blocks get compacted together, which affects on-disk layout, compaction starvation and WAL-replay data safety.
focus: Only one class is planned per call, so stale or selected blocks wait until no-hint planning returns nothing
Overlapping blocks of different classes are never merged and are retained until retention
Behavior is unchanged when only one class exists

units.summary: Comment-only update to the planClass doc describing the new partial-view classes.
units.headline: Update planClass doc comment for selected-series hint
units.reason: Only comment lines changed; no code statements differ.

units.summary: When merging block metas, the from-selected-series hint is now propagated to the merged block if any source carries it, like the stale hint. Comments are updated accordingly.
units.headline: Merged block metas now keep the from-selected-series hint
units.reason: Changes the persisted compaction hints of merged blocks, which feeds inOrderBlocksMaxTime and WAL truncation.
focus: Any-source propagation is correct only because the planner segregates classes; check other callers of CompactBlockMetas
Blocks with both stale and selected hints get both

units.summary: Write now copies the from-selected-series hint from the base block meta to the newly written block, mirroring the stale hint.
units.headline: Write propagates from-selected-series hint from base meta
units.reason: Changes the hints persisted on newly written blocks, which affect WAL cutoff computation.
focus: Callers passing a base meta get the hint set on the output block as intended

units.summary: New happy-path test for CompactSelectedSeries: selected series are evicted, others stay, the block has the hint, HeadMinTime is unchanged, and metrics are updated. Part of the moved test code.
units.headline: Add happy-path test for CompactSelectedSeries
units.reason: New test only; no production behavior change.
